# heading-blank-lines

- ID: `MD022`
- Category: Headings
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `headings`, `blank_lines`
- Also named: `blanks-around-headings`, as in markdownlint

Headings have a blank or comment line above and below.

## Why

Blank lines set headings apart in the source. Some parsers, such as kramdown,
read a heading with no blank line before it as plain text. As in markdownlint, a
heading right after front matter needs none above it.

## Options

Set them under `rules.heading-blank-lines.options`.

- `lines_above` (`integer|integer[]`, default `1`): Blank lines required above a
  heading, or a list with one value for each heading level. 0 or -1 requires
  none.
- `lines_below` (`integer|integer[]`, default `1`): Blank lines required below a
  heading, or a list with one value for each heading level. 0 or -1 requires
  none.
- `include_front_matter` (`boolean`, default `false`): Require blank lines above
  a heading that directly follows front matter.
- `markdownlint_compatible` (`boolean`, default `true`, gomdlint only): Require
  blank lines between adjacent headings, as markdownlint does. With false, a
  heading may touch another heading.

## Fix

The fix inserts the missing blank lines, keeping any blockquote markers.
gomdlint reports a heading in a tight list without a fix when the blank line
would make the list loose. gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when the
fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\],
or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add or remove a task
list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide
Install the tool, then run it.
## Usage
Run it in the project root.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
1:1 Heading needs 1 blank line(s) below, found 0
3:1 Heading needs 1 blank line(s) above, found 0
3:1 Heading needs 1 blank line(s) below, found 0
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

Install the tool, then run it.

## Usage

Run it in the project root.
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  heading-blank-lines:
    options:
      lines_above: 1
```

Under `rules`, `heading-blank-lines: false` turns the rule off and
`heading-blank-lines: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable heading-blank-lines` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line blanks-around-headings -->
```
